events.title: Orange City Fountain Pen Show 2026
events.description:
The Orange City Fountain Pen Show 2026 (also referred to as the Akshar Orange City Fountain Pen Show) takes place on November 28 and 29, 2026, at Govt Chitrakala Mahavidyalaya near Deekshabhoomi in Nagpur. Jointly organized by the Orange City Akshar Foundation and the government college, it is Nagpur's first fountain pen show. • Pen Repairs & Nib Work: Demonstrations on pen repairs, nib customization, and maintaining smooth ink flow led by nib specialist Sameer Mehta and fountain pen expert Yusuf Mansur.
• Calligraphy & Lettering: Basic and advanced calligraphy sessions covering modern brush lettering and cursive writing.
• Contests & Feedback: Open calligraphy and handwriting contests for students and amateur artists, including individual handwriting feedback and prizes for winners.
• Exhibitor Stalls: Pen makers and sellers—such as Abhay Pen Agencies featuring Mohi Akshar fountain pens—are participating in the show.

events.title: Senseless - Standup Comedy Lineup Show
events.description:
Senseless – A Stand-up Comedy Lineup Show

Get ready for an evening of laughter, silly observations, relatable stories, and absolutely senseless humour!

Senseless brings together comedians Aaditya and Alok for a fun-filled stand-up comedy lineup show. Expect jokes about everyday life, relationships, random thoughts, awkward situations, and things that probably make no sense but are hilarious anyway.

What happens at the show?
Two comedians, different perspectives, plenty of jokes, and a room full of laughter. Just sit back, relax, and enjoy the madness!

Who is this for?
Anyone who enjoys stand-up comedy, loves a good laugh, or simply wants to spend their evening doing something fun. Whether you're coming with friends, your partner, or flying solo, you're welcome!

Things to bring:

- Yourself and your sense of humour.
- Your friends (family at your own risk 😉).
- An open mind and a willingness to laugh.

No prior comedy experience required. No special preparation needed. Just bring yourself!

📍 The Comedy Remedy Club, Nagpur
📅 28th November | Saturday
⏰ 8:00 PM

Come for the comedy, leave with questionable thoughts. After all, it's called Senseless for a reason!

events.title: Bird Walk at Gorewada Biopark Nature Trail
events.description:
Bird Walk conducted by Ataavi Bird Foundation and Nayanika Bhatia. 
Rules to follow during birdwatching
Wear camouflage or earthy-toned clothes.
Bring your own binoculars, camera, or phone (if available).
Wear sturdy, closed-toe shoes.
Maintain silence to avoid disturbing the birds.
Avoid using flash photography.
Refrain from feeding birds.
Stay on designated paths and trails.
Turn off or silence mobile phones to prevent noise disturbances.
Do not play bird calls or sounds to attract birds, as it can disrupt their natural behavior

events.title: Sound of Making: Craft of Musical Instruments
events.description:
The Sound of Making: Stories, Materials & Craft of Musical Instruments.

What does it take to turn a piece of wood, a bottle gourd or a few strings into something that makes music?

Musical instruments are more than objects we play. They are stories of human ingenuity, craftsmanship and our relationship with the materials around us.

This session explores the fascinating journey of how musical instruments are imagined, designed and made. From traditional instruments that have evolved over generations to contemporary innovations, we will discover how materials, shapes and construction techniques come together to create sound.

organisers.name: Orange Hunter
organisers.tagline: For Nagpur’s overthinkers, ADHD brains, and anyone tired of pretending they’re fine.
organisers.description: Orange Hunter brings together Nagpur’s neurodivergent and mental health community, welcoming individuals navigating ADHD, autism, dyslexia, anxiety, depression, and other behavioural or cognitive differences. We organise low-pressure, confidential cafe meetups where people can speak openly without stigma or masking. Expect a relaxed, small-group setting built around real conversation, active listening, and shared lived experiences rather than clinical therapy or toxic positivity. Come as you are, share only what you want, and connect with peers who get it.
